propositions: Import documentation does not describe current batching behavior (256-event chunks) and deferred-push semantics introduced by ADR 0039.
Canonical import parser help must be regenerated and verified to match packaged help and CLI reference artifacts before deployment.
Import guidance must explicitly state that whole-file atomicity is not provided and partial tickets are not automatically completed on crash.
Serial source_id-based resumption and concurrent duplicate risk when scans race must be documented as supported and unsupported recovery patterns.
Help generation scripts (gen_cli_help.py, gen_cli_reference.py) must confirm final packaged artifacts and external CLI reference match canonical parser help.
Importer runtime behavior and module behavior must remain unchanged; changes are documentation-only.
